jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Skip to content About The Position Company Overview Our company is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic technology team. We are looking for a strategic technology professional who can drive our cloud infrastructure, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes, and overall system reliability. Job Overview The Senior DevOps Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable and efficient cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines. This role requires a deep understanding of modern cloud technologies, infrastructure as code, and automation strategies. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Design and implement robust cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with Terraform Develop and maintain comprehensive CI/CD pipelines using to GitLab CI Architect and manage containerization strategies using Cloud Managed Kubernetes Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and observability solutions using tools like Prometheus, Grafana Ensure high availability, scalability, and security of cloud environments across Azure and AWS Collaborate with development teams to optimize application deployment processes and improve system reliability Develop and maintain scripts and automation tools to enhance operational efficiency Perform root cause analysis and troubleshoot complex infrastructure and deployment issues Implement and maintain robust security protocols, including access management, network security, and compliance standards Participate On-call activities Requirements Required Technical Skills 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps engineering roles Production-grade Kubernetes projects from the scratch (proven, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes) Expert-level knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation or Pulumi) Advanced scripting skills (Python, Bash, Go) Extensive experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) Strong background in CI/CD pipeline development (Gitlab CI, Github Actions, Azure DevOps) Application management using GitOps approach (FluxCD, Argo CD). Expertise in configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef, Puppet) Advanced understanding of networking, security, and system administration Experience with developing and implementing cloud spending strategies Monitoring: ELK Stack, and CloudWatch Soft Skills Strong communication and collaboration abilities Problem-solving and critical thinking skills Ability to work in an agile, fast-paced environment Passion for continuous learning and technological innovation Excellent documentation and knowledge-sharing capabilities Advantages Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field Professional certifications such as AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer, or Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer preferred Proven track record of successful cloud infrastructure and deployment projects Apply for this job

jobs.title: Director of Product & Design
jobs.description: Skip to content About The Position We're seeking an experienced Director of Product & Design to lead and oversee both Product Managers and Product Designers while defining and executing the product strategy across our enterprise SaaS platform. This leadership role combines strategic vision, organizational leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver exceptional products that drive business growth and customer success. Responsibilities Define and execute the overall product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers and Product Designers Build and scale the Product organization, establishing best practices, processes, and a strong product culture Own the performance and success of the product portfolio, ensuring alignment with company objectives Partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Delivery, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to drive business outcomes Drive product discovery, customer research, market analysis, and competitive positioning Prioritize strategic initiatives based on customer needs, business impact, and market opportunities Define and monitor product KPIs, OKRs, and success metrics to guide decision-making Build strong relationships with enterprise customers, strategic partners, and executive stakeholders Champion user-centric product development while balancing technical feasibility and business priorities Requirements 7+ years of Product Management experience, including significant experience in enterprise SaaS 3+ years of leadership experience managing Product Managers, with experience leading and developing multidisciplinary product teams Experience managing or partnering closely with Product Design teams Proven track record of defining and executing product strategy for enterprise software products Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and product discovery frameworks Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills Strong analytical mindset with experience using product analytics and data-driven decision making Experience with product analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel) Experience with Jira, Confluence, and modern product management tools Strong understanding of technical architectures and enterprise software systems Apply for this job

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description: Skip to content About The Position KMS Lighthouse is one of the hottest up and coming tech companies working with Fortune 500 and Fortune 1000 enterprises around the world! Named the #1 knowledge management company in the Forrester Wave Report 2024, KMS Lighthouse is an industry leader in knowledge management. We are looking for high-energy, driven professionals with natural sales instincts to join our growing sales team! As an Account Executive you will be hunting and closing new business within the US. Ideal candidates should be eager to advance in our organization by demonstrating their ability to grow activity and move things forward to high scales. Responsibilities Develop, manage and prioritize a pipeline of strategic target accounts within a defined territory Drive the sales process from prospect to deal closure Maintain active engagement with new and existing leads through creative and strategic follow-up communications Generate new business opportunities to fuel our growth Build and maintain quality relationships with enterprise-level executives Conduct high level conversations with senior executives in prospect accounts Work closely with internal teams needed to help further the sales process (i.e. Sales Engineers, implementation, etc.) Achieve monthly quotas of qualified opportunities and closed business Requirements 3+ years of experience as an Account Executive, Sales Executive, or similar role selling a SaaS Prior experience in B2B sales, with a proven, successful track record of generating revenue and closing business Prior experience targeting large enterprise organizations or equivalent years of experience selling to mid-market Proven track record of success prospecting for new business Excellent written/verbal communication skills Strong presentation skills Motivation, drive, and a self-starting attitude Benefits Medical, Vision, Dental 401K + 401k Match 11 Paid Holidays PTO & Sick Days Apply for this job

jobs.title: R&D Director
jobs.description: Skip to content About The Position KMS Lighthouse is seeking an experienced R&D Director to lead our global engineering organization and drive the execution of our technology strategy. This role is responsible for leading multiple engineering teams through experienced managers, scaling engineering excellence, and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality, enterprise-grade SaaS solutions. The ideal candidate is a strong people leader with extensive experience managing large-scale engineering organizations in a global environment. They will play a key role in accelerating AI adoption across the engineering organization, embedding AI-driven development practices, and leveraging AI technologies to improve productivity, software quality, and innovation. Responsibilities Lead and scale the global engineering organization through engineering managers, fostering a high-performance culture. Define and execute the engineering strategy in alignment with business and product objectives. Drive AI adoption across engineering by integrating AI-powered tools and development practices that improve productivity, software quality, and delivery. Develop engineering leaders through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and organizational growth. Partner with Product, Architecture, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to deliver scalable enterprise SaaS solutions. Drive engineering excellence by improving development processes, operational efficiency, quality, and execution. Oversee planning, prioritization, resource allocation, and execution across multiple engineering initiatives. Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends to ensure continuous innovation. Requirements 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership of large engineering organizations. Proven experience managing global engineering teams through engineering managers. Strong background in enterprise SaaS and modern cloud technologies. Demonstrated success driving AI adoption and modern engineering practices. Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Experience building and developing high-performing engineering organizations. Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is an advantage. Apply for this job

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative

This is the place to be if you're interested in combining technology, innovation, and sales. Responsibilities Prospecting for new clients. Conduct discovery sessions with clients to pass along to the Sales Executives. Track opportunities using the CRM and follow the sales process as directed by the Sales Executives. Create a pipeline of qualified opportunities. Develop a deep understanding of the KMS and related products. Establish a network of customers and accounts via CRM, LinkedIn, and networking events. A training program will be provided so that day-to-day responsibilities can be carried out. An understanding of HubSpot and Linkedin tools can be advantageous Requirements Experience in enterprise software is preferred, with 1-2 years of experience in lead generation. The ability to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. The ability to multitask, take initiative, prioritize, and manage time effectively. Excellent written and verbal English skills Benefits Clear career progression path A commission-incentivized role Wage competitive with industry standards Fitness memberships Insurance for private healthcare Apply for this job
